judged_text: createAllCalendarEvents now awaits createEvent sequentially per destination inside the for-loop, where the previous code created events concurrently via Promise.all for the multi-credential path. A collective booking with N hosts serializes N calendar API round-trips on the booking request path, adding roughly (N-1) × per-call latency (hundreds of ms each) to every collective booking confirmation for the booker waiting on the response.

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the diff changes from a single `destinationCalendar` to an array and now iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and does `await createEvent(...)` inside the loop when `destination.credentialId` is present. That makes per-destination event creation sequential. Previously, the multi-credential path used `await Promise.all(...)` to run calendar creations concurrently (for the integration-based branch). While this is not a correctness defect, it is a real performance/regression concern on the booking request path when multiple destination calendars exist (e.g., collective/team scenarios).
